cd /app/work && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import gen3, gen2

def check_shape(resp, req):
    assert set(resp.keys()) == {'version','classes','queries'}, resp.keys()
    assert resp['version'] == 1
    sigs = set()
    K = req['window']
    pctx = sum(max(0,len(t['rows'])-K+1) for t in req['probes'])
    for c in resp['classes']:
        assert set(c.keys()) == {'signature','members','representative'}, c.keys()
        assert isinstance(c['signature'], str) and isinstance(c['members'], int)
        assert c['members'] >= 1
        assert c['signature'] not in sigs; sigs.add(c['signature'])
        rep = c['representative']
        assert set(rep.keys()) == {'or'}
        assert 1 <= len(rep['or']) <= req['policy']['max_width']
        seen = set()
        for lit in rep['or']:
            assert set(lit.keys()) == {'atom','negated'}, lit
            assert type(lit['negated']) is bool
            assert type(lit['atom']) is int and 0 <= lit['atom'] < len(req['atoms'])
            assert lit['atom'] not in seen; seen.add(lit['atom'])
        if pctx:
            assert len(c['signature']) == -(-pctx // 4), (c['signature'], pctx)
    qtraces = [(t, sorted(t['rows'], key=lambda r: r['t'])[-1]['t'])
               for t in req['queries'] if len(t['rows']) >= K]
    assert len(resp['queries']) == sum(max(0, len(t['rows']) - K + 1) for t in req['queries'])
    idx = 0
    for t, endt in qtraces:
        n = len(t['rows']) - K + 1
        for _ in range(n):
            q = resp['queries'][idx]; idx += 1
            assert set(q.keys()) == {'trace','end','must','may','status'}, q.keys()
            assert q['trace'] == t['id'], (q, t['id'])
            assert q['end'] == endt, (q, endt)
            assert type(q['must']) is int and type(q['may']) is int and 0 <= q['must'] <= q['may']
            if q['must'] > 0: assert q['status'] == 'violating'
            elif q['may'] > 0: assert q['status'] == 'ambiguous'
            else: assert q['status'] == 'consistent'
    assert idx == len(resp['queries'])

rnd = random.Random(77)
n = 0
for genfn, kw in ((gen3.gen_request, {}),):
    for it in range(400):
        req = genfn(rnd, **kw)
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/main.py'], input=json.dumps(req).encode(), capture_output=True)
        r = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
        if 'error' in r: print('ERR', r); continue
        check_shape(r, req); n += 1
for it in range(60):
    req = gen2.gen_request(rnd, nf=rnd.randint(1,4), natoms=rnd.randint(0,10), k=rnd.randint(1,6),
                           nrows=rnd.randint(0,20), ntr=rnd.randint(0,5))
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/main.py'], input=json.dumps(req).encode(), capture_output=True)
    r = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    if 'error' in r: continue
    check_shape(r, req); n += 1
print('shape checks passed on', n, 'responses')
